# Datacask Documentation

> Self-hosting and user documentation for Datacask database backup management.

This file contains links to documentation sections following the llmstxt.org standard.

## Table of Contents

- [Introduction](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/self-hosting/intro.md): Welcome to the **Self-Hosting** section of the **Datacask documentation**!
- [Docker Compose](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/self-hosting/docker-compose.md): This guide will help you deploy Datacask using Docker Compose. This method is ideal when you want to run Datacask alongside its own dedicated datab...
- [Docker](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/self-hosting/docker.md): This guide will help you deploy Datacask using Docker. This is the simplest deployment method, using a single container that includes everything yo...
- [Kubernetes + Helm](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/self-hosting/kubernetes-helm.md): This guide will help you deploy Datacask on Kubernetes using Helm.
- [Native Ubuntu Installation](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/self-hosting/native-ubuntu.md): This guide will help you install Datacask directly on Ubuntu without Docker. This is useful for environments where Docker is not available or when ...
- [Application](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/self-hosting/configuration/application.md): Core application settings including database, timezone, proxy configuration, and logging.
- [Backup](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/self-hosting/configuration/backup.md): Backup settings (compression, schedules, timeouts, etc.) can be configured directly from the **Configuration** page in the web UI.
- [Notification](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/self-hosting/configuration/notification.md): Notification settings (enable/disable, channels, recipients) can be configured directly from the **Configuration** page in the web UI.
- [SSO](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/self-hosting/configuration/sso.md): Datacask supports OAuth authentication, allowing users to log in using external identity providers. This can be used alongside or instead of tradit...
- [Versioning](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/self-hosting/versioning.md): Datacask follows [semantic versioning](https://semver.org/). The Docker images, Helm chart, and application all share the same version number — ver...

- [Introduction](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/user-guide/intro.md): Welcome to the **User Guide** for **Datacask**!
- [Database Servers](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/user-guide/database-servers.md): Database servers are the source of your backups. Datacask can connect to and backup MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Microsoft SQL Server, MongoDB, SQLi...
- [Storage Volumes](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/user-guide/volumes.md): Storage volumes are the destinations where your backup files are stored. Datacask supports multiple storage backends to fit your infrastructure needs.
- [Backups](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/user-guide/backups.md): Datacask allows you to create on-demand backups of your databases. Backups are processed asynchronously, so you can continue using the application ...
- [Snapshots](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/user-guide/snapshots.md): Snapshots are the backup files created when you backup a database. They contain all the data needed to restore your database to a specific point in...
- [Organizations](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/user-guide/organizations.md): Datacask supports multi-organization setups, allowing you to isolate resources (database servers, volumes, agents, snapshots) between teams or proj...
- [Permissions](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/user-guide/permissions.md): Datacask uses role-based access control built on [Bouncer](https://github.com/JosephSilber/bouncer). A **role** grants a set of **abilities**. Role...
- [REST API](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/user-guide/api.md): Datacask provides a REST API for managing database servers, backups, snapshots, and storage volumes programmatically.
- [MCP Server](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/user-guide/mcp.md): Datacask includes a built-in [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) server that lets AI assistants manage your database b...
- [Development Guide](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/contributing/development.md): This guide covers setting up a local development environment for contributing to Datacask.
- [Remote Agents](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/user-guide/agents.md): A remote **agent** backs up databases that Datacask cannot reach directly — without opening any inbound port to them.
- [SSH Tunnel](https://hjdyzy.github.io/datacask/user-guide/ssh-tunnel.md): Connect to databases that aren't directly reachable from Datacask: in private networks, behind a bastion/jump host, or on a remote Docker host whos...
